messages:
sam: FYI — Emerald Labs reached out about a low-touch EAP for their new accelerator. They want a light marketplace listing + an NDA for early perf runs.
anya: thanks. do we have a standard low-touch checklist for these? can this be mostly self-serve? :thinking_face:
chris: we do, but it’s been internal. happy to paste the short version here. main items: NDA signed, sample image + container creds, perf script, telemetry hook, and marketplace metadata.
oliver: tagging marketplace team — are there extra governance fields they’ll need? I remember a new legal flag for encryption-at-rest wording.
maria: @oliver yes — add both encryption and KMS integration options. also ask partner to confirm SOC2 scope if they want enterprise listing later.
sam: partners-bot created a draft EAP workspace: https://rwd-infr.co/eap/emerald-172999 — contains NDA template + perf harness.
partners-bot: EAP workspace created and shared with sam, anya, chris, oliver, maria. :white_check_mark:
anya: OK next: benchmarks. Emerald wants a quick 1-day microbench then a full run next week. can infra allocate one 8-GPU slot for the 1-day?
chris: I can carve out an 8-GPU pool tomorrow 9–5 PST. will run the standard throughput+latency suite. Please tell them to run their client with this cmd: `./run_perf --model emerald-1 --seq 2048 --batch 1` and drop logs to the workspace.
sam: we'll also enable prefix/KV cache toggles so we can compare economics. add a note to the NDA about sample data retention: 7 days auto-delete.
oliver: marketplace metadata: needs a short description (<= 140 chars), supported regions, required instance types, and a contact email. ask Emerald to provide icons (SVG) and a 1-paragraph value prop.
maria: feedback loop — set weekly sync for first 3 weeks, then biweekly. also create a shared bugtracker board labeled `emerald-eap`.
anya: can we offer them a low-touch telemetry snippet to drop in? something like `/telemetry/ping?eap=emerald&env=preview` — then we can surface perf regressions in console.
chris: yes, we'll add a tiny agent script and instructions. sample: `curl -X POST https://telemetry.redwood.ai/ping -d 'id=EM-123&latency=123'` in the workspace.
sam: approvals needed: legal sign-off on modified NDA (maria), infra quota (chris), marketplace listing template (oliver). if everyone ok, i'll send to Emerald tonight.
oliver: quick question — public announcement? Emerald asked about joint blog in 6 weeks. we should mark that tentative until we have bench numbers and legal ok. put in workspace: `announcement_intent: tentative`.
maria: legal reviewed the NDA draft, one small change to data retention clause. will push redline to the workspace by EOD.
anya: thanks — i'll draft the onboarding email to Emerald once the redline is in. will cc product-marketing for the announcement thread.
sam: timeline summary in workspace: Day 0 NDA + creds, Day 1 microbench, Day 7 full bench, Week 2 first feedback sync, Week 6 announcement decision.
chris: I’ll upload the perf results and a short runbook for reproducing on our infra.
anya: perfect. if no blockers, i’ll send the kickoff and NDA link tonight. :thumbsup:
partners-bot: Reminder set: weekly sync on Monday 09:00 PST for 3 weeks.
